segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Maya, this is Kevin from Northstar Analytics. Yeah, so we need to add 12 seats to our account before our training on May 14. Can you help with that?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Absolutely. I can take care of that. I’m pulling up your account in the admin console now. Can you confirm the billing email on file?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I see you currently have 38 seats on the Business plan, billed annually, renewal date October 1. Adding 12 seats brings you to 50. The prorated charge through renewal is $1,824 before tax. Does that look right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that’s what I expected. Please go ahead.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. The 12 seats are active now, and I sent the updated invoice to ap@northstaranalytics.com. Invoice number is 48291.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do I need to do anything special for the new users?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No, you’re all set. Your account admin can invite them from Users in the admin console. They’ll count against the new seat total right away.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Happy to help, Kevin. Have a good one.
